Wild Aggro Shadow Priest Guide 2026

This ShadowPriest deck is an aggressive burn deck. Use the shadow hero power to pressure face and close games quickly.

Mulligan Tips

Keep Voidtouched Attendant, Papercraft Angel, Twilight Deceptor, Raise Dead, and Shadowbomber.

Do not keep any 4-cost or higher cards.

Hero Power Plan

Darkbishop Benedictus enables the Shadow hero power and Mind Spike plan as a start-of-game transform effect.

The effect matters for the deck plan; the physical card is not an opening-hand mulligan target.
